The average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) is about 3.85 cognitive score points.

I used regression adjustment. I fit an outcome model on the control children using all 25 covariates, then predicted what each treated child's score would have been without treatment. The ATT is the average gap between the treated children's observed scores and those predictions.

Two simpler estimates land close by. The raw difference in mean outcomes is 3.84. A single regression of the outcome on treatment plus all covariates gives a treatment coefficient of 3.83. The covariate adjustment barely moves the estimate.

ANSWER: 3.85
